task_summaries.T001: Baseline validate-extension.sh run on the unmodified tree: 13/13 checks pass at version 1.4.0. Any later gate failure is attributable to this feature.
task_summaries.T002: config-template.yml documents max_items/max_bytes at project level and a new Example 7 for per-source. States plainly that the per-source value is a sub-ceiling (lowers only) unlike max_cache_age which replaces, that absent means no limit with no default applied, and that the budget bounds the index only. schema_version stays 1.0; file still parses.
task_summaries.T003: Added max_items and max_bytes rows to the Configuration Validation Rules table in all three copies (configure, sync, status) as one atomic change, plus a shared subsection explaining why a ceiling of 0 is rejected and why the leading-dash ban does not extend to these two fields.
task_summaries.T004: Verified the three validation blocks remain byte-identical using the same awk range and shasum the CI gate uses: 1 unique hash across all three files. Constitution Quality Gate 11 satisfied.
task_summaries.T005: sync step 1 now distinguishes project-wide from per-source validation failure: a per-source malformed ceiling skips only its source (FR-020), a project-wide one is reported and treated as unconfigured (FR-021) so one typo cannot empty the corpus. Recorded that failing open matches the existing over-age-cache reasoning.
task_summaries.T006: Added Corpus Measurement to sync Algorithm Reference: wc -c via redirection, with du and stat explicitly forbidden and the GNU/BSD divergence for each spelled out, because either would break FR-007 determinism. Size measured over agent-read content, not the index.
task_summaries.T007: Added Context Budget Allocation to sync Algorithm Reference: effective limit as the LOWER of the source's own ceiling and its share, four-step progressive fill run per dimension with ascending-label tiebreak, and an explicit callout that step 2 (releasing unused share) is what fills the ceiling - with the 102-vs-120 counterexample, since omitting it is the exact defect analysis A9 caught in the contract example.
task_summaries.T008: Inserted step 7a 'Apply the context budget' between conflict detection and index writing. Selection is the longest ascending-path prefix fitting both effective limits, with the path-order-over-smallest-first rationale recorded. States it runs on the assembled corpus regardless of provenance (FR-011) and is skipped entirely when no budget is in effect (FR-004).
task_summaries.T009: Added conflict reconciliation as step 7a.3: all versions of a conflicting path are withheld unless every version fits, freed capacity is explicitly NOT reallocated (reuse would make the result pass-count dependent and break FR-007b), the withdrawal is reported as one event, and a source emptied by a withdrawal is named like one that received no allocation.
task_summaries.T010: Step 8 now writes only the selected subset with withholding fields omitted entirely when nothing was withheld (FR-016), and never names a withheld path (FR-014). Step 7a carries an explicit note that manifests are written before it and keep the complete item list - the separation that makes FR-012a, FR-017/FR-035 and FR-034 satisfiable together.
task_summaries.T011: Added ten rows to the sync Error cases summary covering every new path: malformed ceilings per-source and project-wide, a ceiling of 0, an over-project per-source ceiling, an oversized single item, an item ceiling below the source count, an unfittable conflict pair, a non-binding budget, and the advisory warning. Exit code 0 in every row (FR-022).
task_summaries.T012: configure gained step 4a: validates max_items/max_bytes before writing, and clamps a per-source ceiling that exceeds the project ceiling rather than skipping the source, with the message form and the reasoning (one safe reading, so refusing would destroy knowledge to punish a redundancy). The stored file keeps the user's number; the clamp applies at use.
task_summaries.T013: README gained a Context budget section: both keys and scopes, the sub-ceiling-vs-override contrast against max_cache_age, the four-step selection rule stated so a user can reproduce it on paper (FR-007b) with the 120-item worked example and the 102-vs-120 flat-share counterexample, the reporting surfaces, the search guarantee, conflict atomicity, and the advisory threshold for unbudgeted projects.
task_summaries.T014: sync step 9 gained the withholding report: per-source injected-of-total counts and sizes with the limit that produced them, plus individually named oversized items, conflict withdrawals as one event, and starved sources. Includes the explicit guard that a source empty for its own reasons must never be reported as budget-withheld - the defect analysis A9 found in the contract example.
task_summaries.T015: Index format now carries withheld_items, withheld_bytes, limit_items, limit_bytes and a Partial header line, all omitted entirely when nothing was withheld so a non-binding budget is invisible (FR-016). Added the rule that no withheld path is ever named there (FR-014) and the note that two indexes are never byte-equal because of the timestamp and machine-local slugs.
task_summaries.T016: Context Output block gains a fifth numbered line stating the corpus is PARTIAL, emitted only when something was withheld (FR-015), pointing the agent at search for the rest. Block otherwise literal and unchanged; rules stay 70 U+2550.
task_summaries.T017: --verbose now lists withheld identities per source, derived as manifest items minus indexed items so no third record exists (FR-034). Recorded why the list is absent from the default output and, for a different reason, from the index. Added the no-bypass rule (FR-012) with a warning that Quality Gate 10 would not protect a manually invoked budget flag.
task_summaries.T018: Added step 9a advisory warning for unbudgeted projects at 200 items / 2mb, one threshold per dimension since the two ceilings are independent. Names both the measured value and the threshold (FR-032a), alters nothing, exits 0, and records that the figures are calibration not contract.
task_summaries.T019: search now builds its inventory from the per-source .manifest.json files instead of knowledge-index.md (FR-035), with the reasoning recorded: the index is bounded because an agent reads all of it, a search returns only matches, and binding search to the budgeted index would make a withheld item unfindable. Step 4 iterates that inventory and states the budget does not filter it. Missing-inventory messaging keeps its three-way distinction.
task_summaries.T020: status gained a Budget column showing indexed-of-total per source and naming the limit applied (share, per-source, or none), plus a Context budget footer line so the numbers can be checked against config (FR-018). Column and footer are omitted entirely when no budget is configured, keeping the table identical to before.
task_summaries.T021: README gained a Trust model section stating that merging a config change causes a fetch on every teammate's machine and every automated environment including via hooks the reviewer may never run (FR-025), enumerating all four exposures (FR-026) and what does NOT happen - content read as data, never executed, no build step or repo hook (FR-027).
task_summaries.T022: Added the defense inventory table: all seven defenses verified present in the current sync command, each stated WITH what it does not cover (FR-028), since a defense listed without its limits reads as a guarantee the extension does not make.
task_summaries.T023: Added reviewer guidance framing a knowledge-config.yml diff as security-relevant, with a five-item checklist covering url ownership, lookalike hosts, revision pinning, path_filter scope, and the consequence of merging (FR-029).
task_summaries.T024: config-template.yml header now carries a SECURITY block pointing at the README Trust model (FR-030): states the file is committed and shared, that adding a url fetches on every teammate's machine including via hooks, and names the three undefended exposures. File still parses.
task_summaries.T025: Audited the Trust model against the actual command files: all nine claimed defenses verified present (leading-dash rejection, -- separators, read-time validation, --no-checkout, blob filter, both timeouts, path_filter, optional hooks, sha256 integrity). Symlink following is described as currently open and not implemented yet rather than mitigated, satisfying FR-031.
task_summaries.T026: Bumped extension.yml 1.4.0 to 1.5.0, README badge, and added the CHANGELOG [1.5.0] section as one change so the three gate-coupled artifacts stay consistent. CHANGELOG records the search change as a fix (it repairs a guarantee the budget would have broken) and carries a Security subsection naming symlink following as an open, unfixed exposure.
task_summaries.T027: validate-extension.sh: 13/13 pass at 1.5.0. The two most at-risk gates both hold - Quality Gate 11 (three validation blocks byte-identical) and Gate 6 (README badge matches manifest).
task_summaries.T028: Install smoke test into a clean consumer project: 6/6 assertions pass - no scaffolding warning, config scaffolded, all 5 commands registered, version reported as v1.5.0, 15 files installed, 4 hooks registered none carrying arguments.
task_summaries.T029: Built the quickstart fixture for real and ran the documented algorithm against it. Corpus 362 items / 4.33mb exactly as the corrected quickstart claims (A3 fix confirmed empirically). huge.md is exactly 2.4 MiB and is excluded without consuming budget (FR-009). Allocation yields 60/56/4 = 120, matching the quickstart's hand-computed claim. Conflict path present in both sources and selected in both, so atomicity holds.
task_summaries.T030: Verified the exit-0 invariant across all 30 rows of the sync error table: none returns non-zero, including the 9 rows this feature added (malformed ceilings per-source and project-wide, ceiling of 0, over-project per-source ceiling, oversized item, ceiling below source count, unfittable conflict pair, non-binding budget, advisory warning).
